sinopsis.es: Oliver, de doce años, crece con discapacidades y una pasión imparable por crear historias de misterio. Al acercarse a la adolescencia, surgen nuevas complejidades, incluida la historia que aún no sabe cómo contar.
sinopsis.en: Twelve-year-old Oliver grows up with disabilities and an unstoppable passion for crafting murder mystery stories. As his teenage years approach, new complexities surface — including the one story he hasn't figured out how to tell yet.
